steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Set the condition under which vendor addition should not be locked.
Apply the additional configuration required by the case.
Apply a template so the draft can contain a valid configured stage.
Add the minimum line item required for the draft.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a valid schedule before saving the draft.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft.
Navigate to the events list to locate the saved draft.
Confirm the newly saved draft is present in Drafts.
Reopen the specific saved eRFX draft.
Assert that the named control is not offered on the saved draft; the label is unconfirmed in the catalog.
